label: Bible Study
prompt: The _____ withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
verse: The grass withereth, the flower fadeth: but the word of our God shall stand for ever.
note: Everything green fades eventually — the word of God is the one thing that doesn't.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of _____.
verse: And the angel of the LORD appeared unto him, and said unto him, The LORD is with thee, thou mighty man of valour.
note: The angel calls Gideon a mighty man of valour while he's hiding in a winepress. God names you by where you're headed.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The _____ also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
verse: The wolf also shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.
note: Everyone remembers 'the lion shall lie down with the lamb,' but the KJV pairs the lamb with the wolf.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his _____ being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
verse: Now when Daniel knew that the writing was signed, he went into his house; and his windows being open in his chamber toward Jerusalem, he kneeled upon his knees three times a day, and prayed, and gave thanks before his God, as he did aforetime.
note: Daniel knew the lions' decree was signed and still prayed toward Jerusalem, windows open — not a protest, just his habit 'as aforetime.'

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the _____ of the sea.
verse: He will turn again, he will have compassion upon us; he will subdue our iniquities; and thou wilt cast all their sins into the depths of the sea.
note: Sins cast into 'the depths of the sea' — Corrie ten Boom added that God then posts a sign: No Fishing Allowed.
